==Bundles==
* Five gold quality Ancient Fruit are an option for {{bundle|missing||y}}.
* Ancient Fruit is one of the options for the {{Bundle|rare crops||y}}.

==Recipes==
Ancient Fruit is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Ancient Fruit can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Genie Pants.png|36px]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Genie Pants]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Ancient Fruit is not used in any quests.
